title: TRINX GTR C6 China-market carbon 12-speed options
notes: Current China-market indexing identifies GTR C6 matte-black/green and matte-black/brown options as carbon-frame 700C 12-speed bikes; one option explicitly says 蓝图 / LTWOO. A separate index line appends an inconsistent 11-speed token, so exact component detail is accepted only where the current 12-speed option and the official catalog agree. No complete weight, maximum clearance or stiffness result is exposed.
